name: How long does it take to remove kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing kitchen cabinets typically takes one to two days for an average-sized kitchen. The exact timeline depends on the layout, whether the existing countertops are being salvaged or disposed of, and how the cabinets are attached to the walls. Removing upper cabinets usually moves faster than base cabinets, which require disconnecting plumbing, sinks, and built-in appliances first. If your project involves preserving delicate drywall or salvaging cabinets for reuse in a garage or basement, the process requires extra care and can add several hours to the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen cabinet removal projects take one to two days, depending on kitchen size, plumbing disconnections, and whether the cabinets are being salvaged.
